subject.title: fix(cron): honor explicit announce delivery on system-event jobs

question: Should an unpinned `systemEvent` with explicit announce delivery become an isolated `agentTurn`, or should callers continue to opt into isolated execution explicitly?
rationale: The proposed normalization changes both payload semantics and execution boundary, so a mechanical review cannot decide whether convenience should override the established explicit session-target contract.

options.title: Keep isolation explicit
options.body: Retain the current rejection and improve the API or CLI diagnostic to direct callers to create an explicit isolated agent-turn job.

options.title: Adopt automatic conversion
options.body: Accept the new system-event-to-agent-turn contract, then require complete destination handling, preserved execution policy, and live delivery proof before merge.

options.title: Pause the behavior change
options.body: Close or defer this branch until cron ownership defines the intended public contract.

recommendation.title: Keep isolation explicit
recommendation.body: Retain the current rejection and improve the API or CLI diagnostic to direct callers to create an explicit isolated agent-turn job.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a core runtime contract choice rather than a narrow test-only decision.
